statement: Jalapeno adds a new claimant on HBM4 supply in an already-constrained memory market where NVIDIA holds substantial capacity.
why: Another high-volume HBM4 consumer tightens an input that already gates accelerator output.

impact.mechanism: A new six-stack-per-package HBM4 buyer competes for constrained memory allocation, tightening supply available to accelerator makers.

evidence.excerpt: TrendForce notes this is a new contender for HBM4 supply and could impact the already-constrained HBM market where NVIDIA already holds substantial capacity.

confidence.basis: Secondary trade commentary; the Samsung HBM4 supply relationship is reported as believed, not confirmed by the suppliers.
